description: This file contains utility functions for converting and processing Google Generative AI tools, including handling different tool types, converting OpenAI tools, and creating tool configurations.

methods.name: convertToolsToGenAI
methods.description: Converts a list of GoogleGenerativeAIToolType objects into GenerativeAITool objects and creates an optional tool configuration.

methods.name: processTools
methods.description: Processes a list of tools, converting them based on their type and aggregating function declarations.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolToGenAI
methods.description: Converts an OpenAI ToolDefinition into a FunctionDeclarationsTool with function declarations.

methods.name: createToolConfig
methods.description: Creates a tool configuration object based on provided tools and optional extra parameters.
